plan.title: Add QUICKS collapsible section to VSCode extension sidebar
plan.overview: Implement a new "Quicks" TreeView section positioned beneath "Tasks" in the VSCode sidebar. The implementation follows the existing capability-computer pattern: quick-parser.computer.ts handles XML parsing (pure function), quicks-view.capability.ts provides TreeView mechanism, and extension.ts orchestrates wiring. Unlike the TASKS view which groups by status, QUICKS uses a simpler flat list pattern similar to docs-view.capability.ts.

approach.rationale:
Following two established patterns from the codebase:
1. **Capability-Computer Separation**: Pure parsing in quick-parser.computer.ts, VSCode TreeView API in quicks-view.capability.ts. This matches task-parser.computer.ts and tasks-view.capability.ts pattern.
2. **Flat List TreeView**: Using docs-view.capability.ts as the closer template since QUICKS displays a flat list without status grouping. The parent-tracking pattern at docs-view.capability.ts:111-113 enables reveal() for Find functionality.
3. **Header Actions**: Following package.json:126 pattern for view/title menu items with navigation groups to position buttons correctly.
Key architectural decisions: - QuickItem is simpler than TaskItem - no children (actions/files), just a clickable leaf - Status shown as description text, not as grouping parent - FileSystemWatcher triggers refresh callback, same pattern as tasks watcher at extension.ts:418

task.action:
- Add kanbanQuicks view to contributes.views.kanban array (after kanbanTasks, before kanbanConfig): { "id": "kanbanQuicks", "name": "Quicks" } - Add new commands to contributes.commands array: - kanban.createQuick: "Kanban: Create Quick - Fast implementation for simple fixes", icon: $(add) - kanban.findQuick: "Kanban: Find Quick - Search by ID or title", icon: $(search) - kanban.refreshQuicks: "Kanban: Refresh Quicks", icon: $(refresh) - Add menu items to contributes.menus.view/title array: - kanban.createQuick when view == kanbanQuicks, group: navigation@1 - kanban.refreshQuicks when view == kanbanQuicks, group: navigation@2 - kanban.findQuick when view == kanbanQuicks, group: navigation@3
Current views array (lines 50-67): ```json "views": { "kanban": [ { "id": "kanbanTasks", "name": "Tasks" }, { "id": "kanbanConfig", "name": "Config" }, ... ] } ```
Add after kanbanTasks: ```json { "id": "kanbanQuicks", "name": "Quicks" }, ```
Add to commands array (after line 123): ```json { "command": "kanban.createQuick", "title": "Kanban: Create Quick - Fast implementation for simple fixes", "icon": "$(add)" }, { "command": "kanban.findQuick", "title": "Kanban: Find Quick - Search by ID or title", "icon": "$(search)" }, { "command": "kanban.refreshQuicks", "title": "Kanban: Refresh Quicks", "icon": "$(refresh)" } ```
Add to menus.view/title array (after existing entries): ```json { "command": "kanban.createQuick", "when": "view == kanbanQuicks && kanban.hasKanbanFolder", "group": "navigation@1" }, { "command": "kanban.refreshQuicks", "when": "view == kanbanQuicks", "group": "navigation@2" }, { "command": "kanban.findQuick", "when": "view == kanbanQuicks && kanban.hasKanbanFolder", "group": "navigation@3" } ```

pitfalls.pitfall: Must cache QuickItem instances to enable TreeView.reveal() - clear cache on refresh, store by ID in Map
Register commands before they're referenced in menus - VSCode handles this but keep logical order
Use 'quick/**/*.xml' not 'quick/*.xml' to catch nested quick.xml files in {id}/ folders
Must match exactly: "kanbanQuicks" in code must match "kanbanQuicks" in package.json views
